Well, a bunch of small fixes that I just get tired of describing

notes.title: Update: version - 0.23.291
notes.content:
- completely redesigned mechanics of shield inflation and armor repair, now they depend on the ship (no description in button widgets yet)
- remodeled the first level (at the request of "radio listeners"), now the first mission is located in the rings of the planet (test mission).
added heroes and heroes' passives (also not everything is displayed yet).
- small advances in working with the core.
